sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手煞费苦心地隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到最近，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: So, one week ago, I received an email from SoundCloud.
sentences.zh: 就在一周前，我收到了一封来自 SoundCloud 的电子邮件。

sentences.en: An important notice regarding a violation.
sentences.zh: 这是一则关于违规行为的重要通知。

sentences.en: One of our tracks was found to be in breach of their terms of use.
sentences.zh: 我们的一首音频被发现违反了他们的使用条款。

sentences.en: The track in breach was Case 26, Lisa Marie Young.
sentences.zh: 违规的音频是第 26 期：丽莎·玛丽·杨案。

sentences.en: To be honest, I didn't even read their email properly.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我当时根本没有仔细阅读他们的邮件。

sentences.en: Because, straight away, I thought, that's the only episode that we play a full song on.
sentences.zh: 因为我脑子里立马闪过一个念头：那是我们唯一播放完整歌曲的一期节目。

sentences.en: The beautiful track written and performed by Lisa's friend, Alison Crowe, titled Lisa's Song.
sentences.zh: 那首优美的歌曲由丽莎的朋友艾莉森·克劳乌创作并演唱，歌名叫《丽莎之歌》。

sentences.en: I assumed that was the issue.
sentences.zh: 我以为问题就出在这里。

sentences.en: SoundCloud realised there was a song played on the podcast, and they believed there might be a copyright issue or something.
sentences.zh: SoundCloud 发现播客里播放了一首歌，他们认为这可能涉及版权问题之类的事情。

sentences.en: So, I replied to the email, and didn't think too much more of it.
sentences.zh: 于是，我回复了邮件，并没有把这事放在心上。

sentences.en: I knew we had full permission to use the song, and I thought it wouldn't take long to sort the issue out.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们拥有使用这首歌的完整授权，觉得很快就能把问题解决。

sentences.en: A few days passed, and I still hadn't heard anything back from SoundCloud, and the track was still down.
sentences.zh: 几天过去了，我依然没有收到 SoundCloud 的任何回复，而且那期音频也依然处于下架状态。

sentences.en: So, I mentioned it to a friend, who I then showed the email to.
sentences.zh: 于是，我向一位朋友提起了这件事，并把邮件给他看了。

sentences.en: He pointed out that I was completely wrong.
sentences.zh: 他指出我完全想错了。

sentences.en: The violation had nothing to do with the use of a song.
sentences.zh: 这次违规跟使用歌曲毫无关系。

sentences.en: I'll quote directly from the email.
sentences.zh: 我直接引用邮件里的原话。

sentences.en: One of your tracks has been found to be in breach of our terms of use on the grounds of violating an individual's right of privacy slash publicity without their prior consent.
sentences.zh: “你们的一首音频因未经事先同意、违反个人隐私权斜杠宣传权，被认定违反了我们的使用条款。”

sentences.en: The track in question is Case 26, Lisa Marie Young.
sentences.zh: 涉事的音频是第 26 期：丽莎·玛丽·杨案。

sentences.en: So, that changed things a little bit.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这让事情有点不一样了。

sentences.en: If I had actually read the email properly to begin with, I would have realised earlier.
sentences.zh: 如果我一开始就认真阅读那封邮件，我早就该意识到了。

sentences.en: So, I got in contact with SoundCloud again, requesting more information.
sentences.zh: 于是，我再次联系了 SoundCloud，要求提供更多信息。

sentences.en: What individual was making this complaint?
sentences.zh: 到底是哪个人提出了这个投诉？

sentences.en: What are the specifics of the complaint?
sentences.zh: 投诉的具体内容是什么？

sentences.en: You know, give me some more information, SoundCloud.
sentences.zh: 拜托，给我提供更多信息啊，SoundCloud。

sentences.en: Something.
sentences.zh: 随便给点什么都行。

sentences.en: Otherwise, I wouldn't have found it.
sentences.zh: 否则我是绝对不会发现这一点的。

sentences.en: I still haven't heard anything back from SoundCloud at all.
sentences.zh: 我至今还没有收到 SoundCloud 的任何回复。

sentences.en: So, then I woke up this morning to find out that complaints had also been made to Stitcher and iTunes.
sentences.zh: 结果今天早上醒来，我发现 Stitcher 和 iTunes 也收到了投诉。

sentences.en: However, as they don't host the actual files, the complainant was directed to where we hoSt.
sentences.zh: 不过，由于它们并不托管实际的文件，投诉人被引导至我们托管音频的地方。

sentences.en: The complaint was then forwarded on to me.
sentences.zh: 随后，该投诉被转给了我。

sentences.en: The complaint says, quote,
sentences.zh: 投诉内容原话如下：

sentences.en: They do not have my permission to use my name in the audio file and to publicly announce my name, along with my birth date.
sentences.zh: “他们没有经过我的允许，就在音频文件中使用了我的名字，并公开宣布了我的名字以及出生日期。”

sentences.en: It is illegal to do what they did, to list my birthday, name, and city, and my charges, which are not public information.
sentences.zh: “他们列出我的生日、姓名、城市以及不属于公开信息的指控，这种做法是非法的。”

sentences.en: The complaint came from a person who gave the name Chris.
sentences.zh: 这个投诉来自一个自称克里斯的人。

sentences.en: The time codes given in the complaint match the times I talk about Christopher Adair, driver of the Red Jaguar.
sentences.zh: 投诉中给出的时间戳，正与我谈论红色捷豹司机克里斯托弗·阿代尔的时间吻合。

sentences.en: The man who Lisa left the party with, after which she was never seen again.
sentences.zh: 那个丽莎与之一同离开派对的男人，而她在那之后就再也没有出现过。

sentences.en: So, he is the last known person to see her alive.
sentences.zh: 所以，他是目前已知的最后见到她活著的人。

sentences.en: I emphasise last known person.
sentences.zh: 我特意强调是“目前已知的最后一人”。

sentences.en: We aren't making any accusations.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有做任何指控。

sentences.en: And the information about his record that he's complaining about actually came from the Government of British Columbia Court Services online website.
sentences.zh: 而他所抱怨的关于他案底的信息，实际上来自于不列颠哥伦比亚省政府法院服务的在线网站。

sentences.en: Justice.gov.bc.ca.cso.index.do
sentences.zh: Justice.gov.bc.ca.cso.index.do

sentences.en: It's right there, free for anyone to search for and find.
sentences.zh: 它就在那里，任何人都可以免费搜索和查阅。

sentences.en: A Government website.
sentences.zh: 一个政府网站。

sentences.en: The website states,
sentences.zh: 该网站声明：

sentences.en: The information is available to the public to ensure an open and transparent judicial process,
sentences.zh: “这些信息可供公众查阅，以确保司法程序公开透明，”

sentences.en: in order to preserve public confidence in the courts and the administration of justice.
sentences.zh: “从而维护公众对法院和司法行政的信任。”

sentences.en: So, a search comes up with Christopher Adair's year of birth, charges, name, and city.
sentences.zh: 因此，搜索结果会显示克里斯托弗·阿代尔的出生年份、指控、姓名和城市。

sentences.en: We don't actually give his birth date in the episode, just his year of birth.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中其实并没有透露他的具体出生日期，只说了他的出生年份。

sentences.en: The website says,
sentences.zh: 网站上写着：

sentences.en: The court record information may be used without permission for public information and research, provided the material is accurately reproduced.
sentences.zh: “在准确复制材料的前提下，法院记录信息可无偿用于公众信息和研究。”

sentences.en: We acknowledge the website as a source in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目文稿中注明了该网站为信息来源。

sentences.en: We don't say anything that wasn't there in black and white on the site.
sentences.zh: 我们所说的一切，都是该网站上白纸黑字写明的内容。

sentences.en: Information we came across while researching this case.
sentences.zh: 这些是我们调查本案时偶然发现的信息。

sentences.en: If it was in fact Christopher Adair who made this complaint, I didn't realise he was a listener of the show.
sentences.zh: 如果确实是克里斯托弗·阿代尔本人提起的这次投诉，我还真不知道他是这档节目的听众。

sentences.en: We did try and contact him for comment at the time we were researching the case, but we couldn't get in touch.
sentences.zh: 我们在调查此案时确实曾尝试联系他征求意见，但没能联系上。

sentences.en: So, I would like to extend an offer for him to come on and have his say.
sentences.zh: 因此，我想诚挚邀请他来节目中发表他的看法。

sentences.en: We would be more than happy to make that happen, any time.
sentences.zh: 我们非常乐意随时促成此事。

sentences.en: Also, we will be closing our SoundCloud account completely.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们将彻底关闭我们的 SoundCloud 账号。

sentences.en: There is nothing that they offer that can't be done on our website,
sentences.zh: 他们能提供的功能，我们的网站全都能做到，

sentences.en: casefilepodcaSt.com.
sentences.zh: casefilepodcaSt.com.

sentences.en: Episodes can be streamed and mp3 files downloaded directly from our website.
sentences.zh: 听众可以直接从我们的网站在线收听节目并下载 mp3 文件。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。
